verdict.rationale: dLocal is a payments platform, so ML fraud scoring and custom block/review/allow rules are a fair axis for it. The evidence pack contains nothing about fraud scores, risk engines or rule configuration. The nearest items cover PCI compliance, notification signatures and sandbox status simulation, which are adjacent security and testing features rather than fraud screening.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can screen transactions with machine-learning fraud scores and write custom block, review, and allow rules
